audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Lucian all seven stages while the prose (whys[1..5], early/mid) says Mordekaiser owns levels 2-6, and the packet level chart gives Mordekaiser 5/7.
audit.why: Mordekaiser's Death's Grasp (E, 700 range, 16/14/12/10/8s) pulls Lucian in and Obliterate (Q) is increased on a single target, while Indestructible (W) stores damage into a shield he can consume as a heal. Lucian's answer is range discipline, not a lane-2-to-6 lead.
audit.corrected: Stages 2-5 (Level 2, Level 3, Levels 4-5, Level 6, First item) flip to Mordekaiser in both layers; Level 1 and 2+ items stay Lucian.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5] called first item 'your kill window'; his spike order is E+Q at 2-3, R at 6.
audit.why: Realm of Death is 140/120/100s and steals a portion of Lucian's stats for the duration — the single largest swing in the matchup, and it is a level-6 spike, not an item spike.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = Realm of Death; first item still loses to Indestructible sustain; Lucian's real reclaim is 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text named only 'Realm of Death' and never stated the decisive setup: Death's Grasp pull into an isolated Obliterate, or that Obliterate grounds.
audit.why: Mordekaiser's Q carries a grounding flag in the kit data, which denies Relentless Pursuit (E) — Lucian's only exit. That is the interaction that decides every trade.
audit.corrected: State the pull-into-isolated-Q chain and hold E/Flash for the Death's Grasp, not for damage.

audit.why: The missing-interactions rule flags needs-antiheal for Indestructible; report[8] already instructs early Grievous Wounds into his sustain, so the page covers it.

edits.before: E online — dash-weave trades start now: spell, double-shot, dash out before his answer lands.
edits.after: Death's Grasp lands at 2 and an isolated Obliterate follows — stop standing where the pull reaches.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: Both have full kits, but his pull into a solo Obliterate and Indestructible beat any extended string you offer.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Realm of Death — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Indestructible heals back your chip on a 12/11/10/9/8s cycle, so poke at max range and never trade inside Death's Grasp.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Realm of Death forces a 1v1 and steals your stats — hold E or Flash purely to dodge the Death's Grasp setup.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: One item is not enough yet — Indestructible still eats your poke, so farm safe and take only the free doubletaps.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: At 2+ items you reclaim it — kite outside Death's Grasp's 700 range and chunk him before Indestructible refreshes.

edits.before: Passive double-shots win level 1 outright — Q through the wave on his last-hits and weave doubletaps on every step-up.
edits.after: Lightslinger double-shots win level 1 outright — he has only Obliterate at 675 range and no pull to answer your step-ups.

edits.before: Mordekaiser burns Realm of Death on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is your only exit and Obliterate grounds — dash before his Q, never after it.

edits.before: That’s Mordekaiser’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Death's Grasp is up every 16/14/12/10/8s — spend E on damage and the next pull has no answer.

notes: Only 7 games behind the 71.43% win rate; the packet defect and the existing whys[] both point to Mordekaiser owning levels 2 through first item, so the chart was flipped to match the prose rather than the noisy win rate. diff stays FAV. Spell-shield/QSS/tenacity behaviour of Realm of Death is not in the kit text and was not asserted.
